distribution.promotionPolicy: Report-only. Enable the standardized Student-t candidate only when every gated horizon clears the pre-registered CRPS, coverage, PIT, median-invariance, and fit/validation-stability gate with a committed evidence artifact.

scoring.method: quantile pinball integral identity with trapezoidal quadrature
scoring.tailConvention: Endpoint-constant extension over the full probability domain: Q(p) equals the first supplied quantile below the first grid probability and the last supplied quantile above the last grid probability.
scoring.approximationErrorBoundStatement: A numeric approximation-error bound is not estimable from this sparse quantile grid and endpoint-tail assumption.
scoring.label: Approximate CRPS (sparse quantile grid; endpoint-constant tails)

protocol.selectionMetric: fit-window approximate CRPS; validation is scored after selection

bootstrap.difference: baseline CRPS minus selected-fit-nu CRPS; positive favours Student-t

protocol.multipleTesting: Holm correction across the four gated horizons at alpha=0.05

promotionGate.verdict: Report-only: at least one pre-registered gate failed at one or more gated horizons; keep the Student-t candidate disabled and register the empirical-shape follow-up.
